config.EnableSpouseRoomTileFix.name: Spouse Room Tile Fix
config.EnableSpouseRoomTileFix.descripti: Prevents custom tiles near the spouse room from being overwritten when using farmhouse mods. This setting may not be necessary depending on the farmhouse mod you use. Please change this setting from the title screen.
config.DebugSupport.name: --- Debugging Utilities ---
config.DebugSupport.description: The sections below contain settings for debugging utilities provided by T's Core.
config.TimeSkip.name: Time Skip
config.TimeSkip.description: A debugging feature that advances the in-game clock to the configured time while processing NPC schedules along the way. Unlike "hurry_all", which completes NPC movement currently in progress, Time Skip advances the clock itself and applies schedule changes that occur up to the target time. It won't run if the current time is already at or past the configured time.
config.TimeSkipKey.name: Keybind
config.TimeSkipKey.description: Sets the keybind used to perform a Time Skip.
config.TimeSkipTime.name: Target Time
config.TimeSkipTime.description: Sets the in-game time to skip to.
config.TimeSkipDuration.name: Time Skip (Duration)
config.TimeSkipDuration.description: A debugging feature that advances the in-game clock by the configured duration while processing NPC schedules along the way. The skip won't run if the resulting time would go past 26:00.
config.TimeSkipDurationKey.name: Keybind
config.TimeSkipDurationKey.description: Sets the keybind used to perform Time Skip (Duration).
config.TimeSkipDurationValue.name: Duration
config.TimeSkipDurationValue.description: Sets how many in-game minutes to advance each time Time Skip (Duration) is performed.
config.TimeSkipSpeed.name: Skip Speed
config.TimeSkipSpeed.description: Sets how quickly NPC schedules are processed during Time Skip. Higher settings make skipping faster but also increase CPU load. Use a lower setting if Time Skip causes performance issues.
config.TimeSkipNotification.name: Completion Notification
config.TimeSkipNotification.description: Shows a notification when Time Skip finishes.
notification.TimeSkipComplete:
Time Skip complete.
Time advanced to {{Time}}.
notification.TimeSkipDurationLimit: Time Skip (Duration) cannot advance time beyond 26:00.
